# cpanel_apache_handler (Resource)

Manages one custom cPanel Apache handler for a file extension.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_apache_handler" "example" {
  extension = ".example-handler"
  handler   = "example-handler"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extension` (String) The file extension handled by Apache. It must begin with a dot.
- `handler` (String) The Apache handler name.

### Read-Only

- `origin` (String) The Apache handler owner reported by cPanel. Managed entries report `user`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_apache_handler.example .example-handler
```
